irobgoblins.title: Robgoblins

wiki_page.title: Robgoblins
wiki_page.text:
Robgoblins are a race of goblin-like creatures. They are small creatures that live primarily in camps with other robgoblins. They have an affinity for destruction, explosives, magic and stealing.

Many robgoblins are enemies, but there are also robgoblin NPCs and questgivers.

Sub-Races
There are currently two sub-races of robgoblins in two locations. All of them have the basic body shape, skins, ears, and eyes, but there is a difference.

Robgoblins can be found in Sacred Grove. They have green skins, long ears, and big noses. They can also be found in Sunstone Valley, although there are several differences in these two cousins. Such include a red skin tone and a default occupation as a scrapsmith. There is a scrapsmith camp just outside of the hostile area controlled by these small creatures.

ichugawugs.title: Chugawugs

wiki_page.title: Chugawugs
wiki_page.text:
Chugawugs are a race that primarily located in the hometown of Wugachug. They have a fonding for Sasparilla Water (aka Root Beer), and they hold a never ending festival dedicated to it. The only known brewery of Sasparillas is located in Wugachug.

There is also a large amount of chugawugs that serve or have served in the chugawug army, primarily located in Briarwood. There used to be a large amount of chugawugs serving as guards in Sanctuary, but they were forced to leave after the assassination of the King and Queen.

Ever since the queen prior to Queen Valerian, Ayani died they were forced to split, one fraction serving Princess Lavender, one fraction turning into thugs (better known as "Thugawugs") and one fraction staying as guards.

wiki_page.text:

Sub-Races
There are currently two sub-races of trolls in any locations. All of them have the basic body shape, skins, ears, and eyes, but there is a difference.

Regular trolls can be found in any locations expect Snowhill. They have green skins, long ears, and big noses.

Ice trolls can be found in Snowhill, they have light blue skins, large ears, big noses, and red eyes.

imembership.title: Membership

wiki_page.title: Membership
wiki_page.text:
right
Membership was the SC currency which can be used for premium features across Free Realms. Players break through to experience the game at a whole new level, with exclusive content, additional jobs and so much more. More things where they access like exclusive jobs like the Wizard, and more than one character. Membership was also fast and easy. Players must start experiencing the entire world of Free Realms by becoming a Member.

Membership costs
1 Month - $4.99 - 
3 Month - $12.99 - 
6 Month - $24.50 - 
12 Month - $29.99 - 
Lifetime - $34.99 - 

The money value on Station Cash is equivalent to  = $1 United States dollar.

Membership benefits
Players that held an active Membership in good standing were entitled to Membership benefits such as: 
 10% discount on SC and Coin items
 3 Character Slots
 Power Hour
 Capability to level all jobs to Level 20
 Golden Name Plates
 Monthly [Trading Card Game] Booster Packs
 Participation in the VIP program
 Ranking on the leaderboards
 Monthly Member Packs
 Access to participate in Members Only: Quests, Combat instances and Dungeons, Jobs, Items and more

Lifetime Membership
thumb
Lifetime Membership grants access to all membership benefits without having to pay for additional months or renew your lifetime membership during the indefinite lifetime of Free Realms.  
In May of 2013, the Lifetime Membership plan became unavailable for purchase. Players whom purchased the plan prior to its removal kept the Membership plan with the same terms as any other membership.

inecrowart-zombie.title: Necrowart Zombie

wiki_page.title: Necrowart Zombie
wiki_page.text:
Were you looking for the pet pal?

The Necrowart Zombie is an enemy NPC that can be found mainly in Briarwood. It's appearance isn't much to be desired as they walk on all fours, frequently wheeze, are somewhat purple in pigmentation and have a mushroom growing out of their back.

Battle
Necrowart Zombies are mainly found wandering near the stream in Bristlewood, Briarwood and require a level 9 combat job to encounter. They also feature in some dungeons such as the Haunted Mines in Blackspore Swamp (which requires a level 13 combat job to enter) except they are referred to as Shamblers and do not have a mushroom growing out of their back. They also feature at Super Spooktacular when the Pumpkin Prince arrives. Sometimes the Pumpkin Prince will spawn a spawner which will spawn hostiles such as Grave Elementals and Necrowart Zombies.

Also if you own a level 11 or above farm you can purchase a fungus sprayer from the vending machine on your farm. This enables you to turn yourself and others into necrowart zombies. Also at Halloween if you are attacked by the Pumpkin Prince then a chance that you will turn into a necrowart zombie and lose your ectoplasmic shooter and will have to pick up another one once the effect has worn out.

wiki_page.title: Black Widow
wiki_page.text:
Black Widows are a race of arachnid that live exclusively in Briarwood and Blackspore Swamp. Most black widows serve as dungeon enemies with the few exceptions such as Spinnerette. Black widows found in Briarwood serve under the rule of Queen Arachnia and the forest troll boss, General Grexan; while the black widows found in Blackspore serve under the rule of Necrosis.

Baby black widows are known as hatchlings, and often appear spawning out of eggs in the dungeon instances Arachnia's Lair and Haunted Mines.

Difference
There is a difference between its gender. Male black widows tend to have smooth legs and two fangs; while the female black widows have hairy legs, four fangs, and a spike at the end of their abdomen. Although their eyes and skin are different.

wiki_page.title: Bristlewood Vulture
wiki_page.text:
The Bristlewood Vulture is an enemy NPC that mainly reside in Bristlewood, located in Briarwood.

Battle
You will find them standing stationary somewhere in the woods and can only encounter them if you are ranked level 9 or higher in a combat job. Bristlewood vultures have a reasonably unique ability also, after they have been defeated in combat they somewhat "evolve" into an undead vulture known as a vengeful vulture.

Trivia
Bristlewood vultures resemble real life vultures except obviously with an animated look about them.

wiki_page.text:
Seaside is a resort town located on the western coast of Sacred Grove. It has a tropical climate and has a great view of the ocean from the Boardwalk and the beach. thumb|Singing Crystal Mines

That mining place is toward the north side of Snowhill in the Singing Crystal Mines. There are also rich mining veins in the world that members can only mine from. To mine you make groups (three or more) of similarly colored tiles. Your goal is to get whatever you are mining to the bottom of the board.

imerry-vale.title: Merry Vale

wiki_page.title: Merry Vale
wiki_page.text:
Merry Vale is a town south of Wugachug, west of Sanctuary, and east of Seaside. Merry Vale is themed on the season of spring, as you can see many sunflowers and other floral growing. In the center is a large rainbow, which is called the Ever Rainbow, where the Rainbow Festival is held all year round.

According to Arianna, before Merry Vale existed, it only rained until the Ever Rainbow sprouted. Contestants "sacrifice" themselves in the rainbow and go to a different world, which is not known to people of Sacred Grove. Fairies are known to originate from this area.
thumb|300px
History
The land where Merry Vale now sits was once barren, mountainous, and unexplored. One day (and no one can truly pinpoint which day), the mountains erupted, and a bright rainbow sprang forth. Curious travelers and adventurers went to investigate, and found the settlement of Merry Vale - home of the fairies.

It was as though the place had been around for ages, but was hidden by magic. The fairies welcome all travelers to celebrate with them in an endless party... but is there something darker lurking at the heart of Merry Vale?

Festival of Hearts
During February, Merry Vale holds an event called Festival of Hearts, or alias, Valentine's Day. Stone Heart, and his minions try to break all the people's love and ruin Festival of Hearts, but it's up to you to help the people and defeat them.

isnowhill.title: Snowhill

wiki_page.title: Snowhill
wiki_page.text:
Snowhill is a city directly north of Sanctuary. It sits high in the mountains, ringed by towering peaks, and is blanketed with a permanent layer of snow. Snowhill is a town devoted to the season of winter, and it has snow all year round. Snowhill not only is a popular attraction for it's looks, but it holds important mining areas, dungeons, and is the only area known to spawn snowballs and have snowball fight minigames with other players. It's inhabitants range from wolves to humans/pixies to yetis.

An unusually large pine tree dominates the town, The main road into town leads directly to this tree, and then loops around it. All other roads extend off this loop. Snowhill has many areas to explore, especially for those who enjoy mountain climbing and winter sports.
thumb|300px
Snow Days
During December, Snowhill holds an event called Snow Days, or alias, Christmas. The giant tree in the heart of Snowhill is known as the Gifting Tree. On top is a pretty star with lights, and it literally pops out presents. The Evil Snowmen try to steal the presents, but it's up to you to help the people and defeat them.

iblackspore-swamp.title: Blackspore Swamp

wiki_page.title: Blackspore Swamp
wiki_page.text:
Blackspore Swamp is a town located in the southeast corner of Sacred Grove. It is a dark and gloomy swamp where there is little difference between night and day. Amid the bogs are rotting remains of what existed before the Unbinding including archaeological sites, the Ancient's Wall, and myriad fossils to be collected.

Blackspore is roughly rectangular in shape with the long dimension running north and south. The western side is swampy terrain and the eastern side is submerged under a dark lake. The main outpost, Mire's Edge, is clumped into a loose knot along the shore. Just north of Mire's Edge is Mucklewhump's Ferry. The presence of old man Mucklewhump gives the impression he once gave boat rides to the Isle of Tears out on the lake. South of Mire's Edge is the Ancient's Wall, and south of the wall is the Sinking Graveyard, Shadowtalon Dojo and the Quagmire Quarry. There's a lot of mystery surrounding the quarry and the unexplained deaths of some of the miners. Blackspore is separated from the rest of Sacred Grove by a mountain range that rings the town. There are two tunnels under the mountains that lead to town and there is also a warpstone in Blackspore near Mire's Edge.

During the annual event Super Spooktacular, Blackspore is home to the Vampires vs. Werewolves Dance-off, which takes place just outside the gates of the Bone Bog Cemetery. The Dance-off is hosted by the Pumpkin Prince, whose tomb is in a corner of the cemetery. Many of the Super Spooktacular quests involve searching around Blackspore and crossing swords with the many haunts found here.
thumb|300px
History
Long before the Unbinding, the area now known as Blackspore Swamp was a beautiful rolling landscape, full of lush forests, fertile fields, and sparkling springs. Now Blackspore is a vast, seeth

ibriarwood.title: Briarwood

wiki_page.title: Briarwood
wiki_page.text:
Briarwood is a dark, brooding wilderness composed of the sub-regions Briarheart, Bristlewood, Nettleseed, and Thistlerow. At the beginning of Briarwood, you will find a hedge maze that has a path leading to the other side. Chugawug guards are found patrolling in many places, and are rumored to be sent by the queen of Briarwood, Darkthorne. Travelers between the two countries would go far out of their way to avoid having to venture close to Briarwood. Tales of mushroom zombies and man-eating plants was enough to leave Briarwood mostly undisturbed. Inhabitants can include wild man-eating plants, animals (including large spiders and ravens), and bandits.
thumb|300px
History
Briarwood is home to strange plants and big tree like creatures. Ever since Darkthorne moved there, taking half the heart seed with her to make another tree similar to the World Tree, instead it's dark and purple like. Chugawugs, mostly soldiers are station there as well, to defeat the man-eating plants and protect the farmers and Darkthorne.

Briarwood World Tree
This is the second World Tree in Sacred Grove, the first that is in Sanctuary and Queen Valerian lives and rules. Her sister Darkthorne, took half the Heartseed to Briarwood, which she rules, and there for isn't an actual area in Sacred Grove, but actually a ruling area by it's self. It is as big as the World Tree in Sanctuary, but is more darker and brooding looking, and matches the flora and fauna of Briarwood. And unlike the original world tree, the one in Briarwood is surrounded by a mountain range, and is like on a island surrounded by water, but a cobblestone road through the mountain leads to the Briarheart Palace front door, which is guarded by a general in Darkthorne's army.

Sub-Regions

ibriarheart.title: Briarheart

wiki_page.title: Briarheart
wiki_page.text:
Briarheart is a small place located in the northeastern part of Briarwood. It is the home of Darkthorne - Queen Valerian's twin sister. Ever since her parents were assassinated, Lavender and the chugawugs were exiled from Sanctuary. Princess Lavender assumed the name of Darkthorne (the name of Ayani's twin sister), tore off a part of the Heartseed, and fled to Briarwood along with a few chugawugs. Briarheart Palace, a dark replica of the World Tree, grew from the Heartseed half which Lavender tore off.

To enter Briarheart the first time, you must prove yourself to the commander of the Tanglewood Fort in Nettleseed. There is a warpstone inside, so you only need to do this once.

There are no collections spawns in Briarheart, but there is an Exploration collection, Briarwood - Briarheart. There is a Locked Treasure Chest, here, too. There is also no farm, but Rich Gold Mining can be found in plenty.

Briarheart is divided into two sections by a mountain range, with a tunnel connecting the two. The front half, which is where the back door of the Tanglewood Fort is. Here you will find the Croaking Vale, a hard dungeon. In the back half, at the "heart" of Briarheart, is the Briarheart Palace, a World Tree like the one in Sanctuary, but a dark echo of that tree's brightness.  Also, at the top of a switchback trail in the south, is the Briarheart Caverns, a hard dungeon.

The Memorial Caverns are caves filled with mostly underground running water, and has murals in which tell the history of Sacred Grove. Inside it is rich with history and life, with plenty of pixies, humans, and even a changeling seeking assistance. It is located north of the World Tree in Sanctuary, and is also the home of the fabled Heartseed, a pivotal object in Sacred Grove's past, which Princess Lavender tore apart to create the Briarheart Palace.

Forgotten Caves

thumb|300px

This new group wanted to control everyone, for they reasoned that they were best suited to tell people how to live their lives. This was the beginning of the Gloam Council.

idarkthorne.title: Darkthorne

wiki_page.title: Darkthorne
wiki_page.text:
Darkthorne (known as Princess Lavender) is the queen of Briarwood, and the sister of Queen Valerian.

She began ruling over Briarwood after the assassination of her parents, Geoffrey, Valerian's loyal and most trusted advisor, blamed Lavender and the Chugawugs and they were exiled. She stole half the Heartseed from the Royal Palace and took it to Briarheart, where Lavender tore the Heartseed apart and grew a new version of the World Tree and named it Briarheart Palace. She then assumed the name of Darkthorne, Ayani's twin sister.

In the Free Realms comic series, it is explained how Darkthorne was blamed by Geoffrey for poisoning her sister Queen Valerian. We learn that this is false, and at the end of the issue 6, it is explained how Geoffrey had poisoned Queen Valerian. It cames out to a happy ending where Darkthorne and the two protagonists, Dane, and Maya get an antidote to Queen Valerian and save her. Darkthorne disappears seconds before Queen Valerian wakes up.

wiki_page.title: Fairies
wiki_page.text:
Fairies are tiny little creatures that look a lot like miniature pixies, but with curling antennae sprouting from their foreheads. They fly all over Sacred Grove, although most fairies can be found in Merry Vale.

History
The story of the fairy race is told by Talespinner Yvelle through a series of quests. The story goes as follows:

The beginning of the world, the region where Merry Vale is now, was no different than anywhere else. Then one day, a storm enveloped the region and lasted for days. Many people thought the storm would never end as the rivers overflowed their banks. Suddenly, however, as quickly as the storm began, it ended, and a rainbow appeared. The rainbow remained emitting vibrant colors even after the sun came out and the clouds gave way. Soon clusters of flowers began appearing around the rainbow, their buds remained closed, however, until many days later when they opened up. The fairies emerged from these flowers, their skin bearing the colors of the rainbow itself and calling this land their home.

The Singing Crystal Mines is a mining corporation located in Snowhill, in which mostly pixies, chugawugs, and dwarves work. It is one of the five mines in-game and one of the three to be found in an actual cave; the others being in Briarwood and in the Southern Wilds near the Lavender Coast Pass warpstone. It is full of different mining games of different materials, mostly copper ore and turquoise. Moreover, it's the largest mine in material.

Outside sits the welding anvil for Blacksmith's making this possibly the best location work to work with in blacksmithing before the release of Sunstone Valley.

igd: Snow Days Toy [2013 Edition]

wiki_page.title: Pumpkin Prince
wiki_page.text:
The Pumpkin Prince is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Super Spooktacular. He is the pumpkin monster, his main goal while arrived is to terrorizing the four locations, though his goal was said to rule all of Sacred Grove.

Battle
Open World
During the Super Spooktacular, a message will pop up saying "The Pumpkin Prince is terrorizing in <Warpstone>". While the Pumpkin Prince is arrived, ectoplasmic destabilizer dispseners appear on the pathways of four locations which you will find somewhere near where the Pumpkin Prince is (he is walking around somewhere in that area and anyone can attack him). All you must do is keep firing at him with your ectoplasmic shooter which will be at the bottom of your screen where your combat moves are.

The Pumpkin Prince can spawn undead enemies such as grave elementals or necrowart zombies that will attack you with effects that slow you down. The Pumpkin Prince can also attack you with himself and if he strikes you will be turned into a necrowart zombie and lose your ectoplasmic shooter ability. You will have to pick up another one when the effect wears off.

Once defeated, he will cry a call in defeat and drop a treasure chest, which will give you a limited Super Spooktacular reward. If he wins he will cry a call of victory and will not drop anything.

Bone Bog Cemetery
The Pumpkin Prince appears in the Bone Bog Cemetery, located in Blackspore Swamp during the Super Spooktacular, which at one point will require you to encounter him in a battle which requires you to be level 13 combat job or above to enter. You going to the dungeon with Lucinda. You will go to fight against the Pumpkin Prince, and send his undead army back to the ghost world. The Pumpkin Prince also spawn the ghosts which will heal him in a battle

ijackpot-plant.title: Jackpot Plant

wiki_page.title: Jackpot Plant
wiki_page.text:
thumb
thumb

A small tree that grows coins for 30 days! Be sure to water it and harvest it every day. After 30 days it will transform into a Golden Jackpot Plant.

The Jackpot Plant was a small tree formerly available in the SC Marketplace for  that grew coins for 30 days. If you watered and harvest it every day for 30 days it transformed into a Golden Jackpot Plant. The Jackpot Plant is no longer obtainable.https://help.freerealms.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/25150/~/jackpot-plants

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Details about the Jackpot Plant
Once you place the plant at your house, it can't be returned to inventory. You can reposition it, though.
The newly placed plant is the Small size. It can grow into Medium and then Large sizes.
To water the plant, just click on it and the water level is refilled.
The water level will drop to one-half after 4 hours.
If not re-watered, the water will empty out after 14 hours.
The plant will wither if it's not watered within 24 hours. It will also drop a size, if it's not already small.
After another 24 hours without water, it will drop another size, if it's not already small.
Your friends can visit your house and help you keep your plant watered. Doing this will give them 50 coins per watering.
Friends can water a plant every 15 minutes.
Players can water 25 plants that they don't own, in every 24 hours.
If your plant is kept properly watered for 24 hours, then you will be able to harvest coins from it.
When placed, the plant is in the Bare state.
This transforms into the Budding stage after 12 hours.
When your plant Blooms, every 24 hours (if kept watered), you can click on it to receive that day's crop of coins.
500 coins from small plants.
700 coins from medium plants.
1,000 coins from large plants.
After 30 days, the plant enters

icakenstein.title: Cakenstein

wiki_page.title: Cakenstein
wiki_page.text:
Cakenstein is an enemy NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Birthday Bash. He is a mutant-like walking cake that appears during the only Birthday Bash and in Treasure War. His main goal is to eat the cakes made for the birthday of Free Realms. Cakenstein was created by a robgoblin chef, Glerga. He is often accompanied by cakelings.

Battle
Open World
During the Birthday Bash, a message will pop up saying  "Cakenstein has risen in <Warpstone>". While Cakenstein is risen, fireworks appear in crates on the pathways of eight locations near Cakenstein. You must fire fireworks at him, but while fighting him, he will run around the area, eating the cakes and getting stronger while doing it.

Cakenstein can also spawn cakelings which bring cake to him. If they succeed, Cakenstein will becomes invincible for a short amount of time.

Once defeated, Cakenstein will melt and drop piles of cakes and a treasure chest, which will give you a limited Birthday Bash reward. If he wins, he will successfully eat birthday cakes and disappear, and he will not drop anything.

Cakenstein Attacks!
Cakenstein appears in Queensfields, located in just outside Sanctuary. This battle requires you to be level 13 or higher to start. Cakenstein is trying to eat more birthday cakes, and you must stop him before he becomes any stronger. During the battle he spawns cakelings which will attack you. He also seems to have a weakness of the Fire Power-Up if you use Fire Power-Up to attack him.

Dialogues

Boss Cake
Cakenstein is included in the Birthday Bash SC Marketplace item named the Boss Cake. The Boss Cake grants players an illusion to appear as a boss.

Open World Battle
During the Snow Days, a message will pop up saying "Snowman Invaders are stealing presents in Snowhill". While the Abominable Snowman is arrived, the snowball piles appear on the pathways of Snowhill which you will find somewhere near where the Abominable Snowman is. Bring snowballs to throw him and stop the snowmen from stealing presents.

Once defeated, the Abominable Snowman drops a special treasure chest that rewards the players that assisted in that specific battle a Snow Days themed item. If he wins, he will successfully stealing presents that will make all the people upset and disappear, which will not drop anything.

Dialogues

TCG
220px|right
In December 2012 during the Snow Days, a Trading Card Game promotional Hero card was introduced based on Abominable Snowman in a Heroes TCG Bundle. The bundle contained two Baron von Darkcheat Booster Packs, two Heroes Booster Packs, and one Abominable Snowman promo card. The card's ID is 4P24.

Boss Cake
The Abominable Snowman is included in the Birthday Bash SC Marketplace item named the Boss Cake. The Boss Cake grants players an illusion to appear as a boss.

Appearances
Free Realms Holiday TV Spot
Trading Card Game Series 4
Free Realms Snow Days Commercial

Gallery

Trivia
Unlike the three seasonal bosses, the Abominable Snowman is the only seasonal boss that didn't have the combat minigame.

iblack-forest.title: Black Forest

wiki_page.title: Black Forest
wiki_page.text:
Black Forest was an unreleased location that was never opened to denizens of Sacred Grove. It would've been located in east of Stillwater Crossing. After a winding path up a mountain, you will only find a lone merchant standing across the bridge and its entrance is blocked by barriers.

Very little is know about that, the mysterious merchant known as Cragara mentioned that she was resting after a long journey from Black Forest during her shops were closed.

Like other unreleased locations, Black Forest was never added to Free Realms before it was shut down on March 31, 2014.

Trivia
Black Forest is the first unreleased location there is no concept art for it.
Despite the fact that Black Forest was never seen, we see concept arts of the forest areas in the Free Realms Filter, it is possible it show what Black Forest could've looked like.

isilver-hills.title: Silver Hills

wiki_page.title: Silver Hills
wiki_page.text:
Silver Hills was an unreleased location that never opened to denizens of Sacred Grove. It would've been located in north of Snowhill, there is the Crystal Barrier that is said to block passage to the lands of the Elves.

The Elves have been living in Silver Hills, protected from danger beyond the Crystal Barrier, since the occurrence of the Unbinding. The only known elf to have left the Crystal Barrier's protection had been Chugzy.

Like other unreleased locations, Sliver Hills was never added to Free Realms before it was closed on March 31, 2014.

Gallery
Concept Arts

Designs

Trivia
Silver Hills was the only location to not have construction barriers on it's entrance in Snowhill.
Despite the fact that Silver Hills was never seen, though in the concept art of Silver Hills, it can seen where Silver Hills would have contained giant crystals and a purple path. It is possible that it would have been in the cave under the mountain.

iqueen-valerian.title: Queen Valerian

wiki_page.title: Queen Valerian
wiki_page.text:
Queen Valerian is the queen of Sanctuary, sister to Darkthorne, and the ruler of all the pixies scattered across Sacred Grove. She is a direct descendant of Ayani, the legendary heroine who sprouted the Heartseed, Queen Valerian's home.

She began ruling over Sanctuary after her parents had been assassinated and her sister Princess Lavender exiled to Briarheart due to the fact that Princess Lavender was blamed by Geoffrey for poisoning her sister, though he was the real culprit. She lives a regal but sad life for her family has been separated and the only people who are close to her are her loyal servants along with Geoffrey, who is secretly plotting against her (although after the player completes the Royal questline, the player confronts Geoffrey and finds out that he poisoned her parents). Members in Sanctuary can enter a party that teleports you behind the Pixiewood Hills sign, if you get inside you can eat a cupcake consumable and appear as Queen Valerian.

icrystal-barrier.title: Crystal Barrier

wiki_page.title: Crystal Barrier
wiki_page.text:
The Crystal Barrier is a giant blue crystal that is located in Snowhill. It is what sealed off the Elves from the other races during the Unbinding. The barrier is believe to be the gateway to the other side of the mountain which is Silver Hills. An elderly pixie, named Silversnow, waited in front of the Crystal Barrier for it to opened and to be reunited with the other elves. But it never opened before Free Realms was shut down.

ielves.title: Elves

wiki_page.title: Elves
wiki_page.text:
The Elves are a race of humanoids native to Silver Hills. They were sealed into Silver Hills behind the Crystal Barrier in Snowhill since the occurrence of the Unbinding.

Silversnow was seen waiting for the Elves to return from the Crystal Barrier.

Notable Elves
Wugachug
Chugzy

Memorial Caverns Murals
Unnamed female elf

Free Realms Issue 3
Elvis

Gallery

Trivia
The Elves were one of the four original races (Dwarves, Humans and Pixies). Players aren't able to choose them as their race.
Only one elf was introduced in Sacred Grove, being Chugzy on August 13, 2013.
Chugzy only have a bright turquoise skin color. A female elf from the Memorial Caverns Murals and Elvis from the Free Realms Issue 3 seem to has peach skin color, thus implying that there are different skin colors of the elf race.

wiki_page.title: Bruce
wiki_page.text:
Bruce is a semiretired human NPC rockstar well known for his past performances in Snowhill and Wugachug. Bruce is currently located in Queensfields, Sanctuary as a merchant.

Performances
Snowhill 2009
thumb|300px|Bruce at Snowhill
During the first months of Free Realms after launch in April 2009, Bruce had been located on the Snowhill Stage where he performed an endless loop of the Free Realms theme song, "It's your world" covered by The Dares.

The 1M Party
On Friday May 15, 2009 at 5pm Pacific Time, the Free Realms Ambassador team held a bash at Snowhill in celebration of Free Realms reaching one million registered users within 17 days of launch. The event reported to have had tons of players visiting Snowhill to hang out, dance and have a party. Crowds of players from the party had reached out all around the area, and eventually formed a crowd around Bruce, who had been performing on the nearby Snowhill stage at the time.

The Dares
Bruce had held solid on his performance for many months and up to early June 2009 as he went on tour, leaving the Snowhill Stage vacant at the time The Dares held their Live E3 Performance on June 2, 2009.

Wugachug 2009
On June 5, 2009 Bruce made his appearance on the Wugachug Stage, where he continued to perform his endless loop of "It's your world". Bruce had continued performing on the Wugachug Stage until he was removed on August 14, 2009. August 14, 2009 was also the day of the update that Free Realms went international, possibly directly linking to his removal as the song "It's your world" covered by The Dares is only available in the English language. It was then said that Bruce had semiretired from performing.

Wugachug Rock Out

thumb|300px|He’ll get you set up with the supplies you’ll need, as well as some useful information.
Farmer is a job that is available since May 2011, unlike other jobs, it is not in the rotation. Farmer Wug’s cousin, Farmer Chug, will be waiting on the farm to help us out. To get there, first open the Houses menu. Everyone will start out with one free farm: the Wilds Farm. You may access your farm by clicking on “Houses” just like accessing one of your houses or lots. Farmer Chug will give you advice and quest, which helps you level up. Farmer Chug is a quest giver, he gives you quest  and his first task is pulling out weed.

You can get coins and various items from Farming including Vaultberries in Station Cash item.

If you do farming at power hour you should get a lot of spins and spin out of the beret witch this way you will get  each try plus you might get a beret witch you can sell for more coins or you can have your self.
You should use your soils by putting them down then next time you use the Tiller you will still have that many soils left and you will have twice as many soils this method takes longer but will save your money.

The Robgoblin Camp is an settlement area home to many robgoblins that is located northwest of Lakeshore. It is where the famous wizard, Fizzlesticks, and a masterful chef, Glerga, have made their homes. The robgoblins in this camp are known for swindling items from nearby towns, and are usually kept under a close watch, especially by the village of Lakeshore.

Visitors to the camp are welcomed to entertain themselves with a game of checkers or chess, or utilize the cooking table to create various recipes. The robgoblins are fans of putting on shows, with a stage act constantly going on for passing travelers and locals alike to stop and enjoy.

While robgoblins are not known for their pleasure of sharing their treasures with outsiders, a few merchants here do offer some goods for a price.

The Boombox XVD-S was the very first boombox Free Realms released. It has unlimited uses. It costs .

To use a boombox, click on About Me on your task bar. Then click on the Consumables button (it looks like a potion bottle).

wiki_page.title: Gloam Council
wiki_page.text:
The Gloam Council is a group that comprised of former members of the peaceful Gleam Council. This group of leaders built a magical artifact that led to the Binding.

The Council's Origins
The Gloam Council was formed of people who, over time, split off from the Gleam Council, the governing body of the precursor civilization in the Age of Harmony. These members were the ones who disagreed with the Gleam's decisions on several subjects, the main one being how to control the use of Magic. These members began meeting in secret, as they shared the belief that peace could only be obtained through the elimination of free will. They plan to control the population, the story of which can be found in the events of the Binding.

The Council During Gameplay
The council during the events of the game is that of a shadow council; not much is seen or heard of them; however, many current and former members are known. The council was seldom seen, outside of the main questline and a few quests and battle instances, that was, until the Shrouded Gloam event, in which the Gloam launched an attack on Shrouded Glade. From then on, their presence was more prevalent in the game, with their influence being used in the rise of the Skullz biker gang in Sunstone Valley, and then later when their invasion of Sacred Grove became real. The Gloam is led by the entity only known as the Gloam Overlord, a person who is only manifested in-game as a floating mask suspended by appendages made purely of gloam magic. The Gloam led several invasions in the game's latter history, attempting to take over first Merry Vale, then Wugachug, then finally Seaside. There would have probably been more to come; however, the game ended just after the Hero's Journal Seaside Questline was launched.

wiki_page.title: Banking
wiki_page.text:
thumbThe concept of Banking is to store items in a storage bank to retrieve at another time. Banking solves many issues such as builders storing unneeded furniture in bulk. This feature was introduced on December 4th, 2012.
Storage
Each player starts with 25 slots of storage, this can store up to 25 individual items. Same items that are the same tint can also be stacked in one slot. Players can purchase additional slots through the Station Cash Marketplace or the Coin Shop.For the Coin Shop upgrades, it is required that the upgrades be purchased in chronological order.
2-Slot Bank Upgrade 1 - 
4-Slot Bank Upgrade 2 - 
6-Slot Bank Upgrade 3 - 
8-Slot Bank Upgrade 4 - 
10-Slot Bank Upgrade 5 - 
20-Slot Bank Upgrade 6 - 
40-Slot Bank Upgrade 7 - 
60-Slot Bank Upgrade 8 - 
80-Slot Bank Upgrade 9 - 
100-Slot Bank Upgrade 10 - 
Whereas the SC Marketplace upgrade contains no limit on amount purchased
50-Slot Bank Upgrade - 
Additionally players with a Membership that logged on during the month of June 2013 also received 200 free storage slots being apart of the June 2013's Monthly Membership Pack.
Storing
To store items, it is required to either visit a Robgoblin Banker or a Storage Vault. The Robgoblin Bankers are marked on the atlas and can be teleported to.
Burglz in Seaside near the Seaside Post Office.
Bezzle in Sanctuary near Poe Tatters.
Yoink in Snowhill near the Snowhill Post Office.
Additionally players with a Membership that logged on during the month of June 2013 also received a free Storage Vault being apart of the June 2013's Monthly Membership Pack.The Storage Vault is a Housing item and can be placed in a Lot. From there, players can access their storage slots from clicking on the Storage Vault.

wiki_page.text:
thumb|400px

Achievements are a reward system added to the game on February 14, 2013.Free Realms - NEW ACHIEVEMENTS AND TITLES! on Youtubehttp://forums.station.sony.com/freerealms/posts/list.m?topic_id=37279 They are rewarded for completing various tasks in the game, such as leveling up your jobs, having your pet do tricks, and completing mini-games. igreenwood-forest.title: Greenwood Forest

wiki_page.title: Greenwood Forest
wiki_page.text:
The Greenwood Forest is a forest area located in Sacred Grove. It is the large, heavily wooded area west of the Lavender Coast Pass warpstone.

Local Places
Ambrose's Dig Site
Greenwood Camp
Southvale Quarry
Farnum's Farm

Questline
Ambrose Worcester:
Friendly Competition
Turning the Tables
Digging for Glory

Two Camps in The Forest
The Greenwood Forest leads to two camps: Camp Chatty and Camp Robbie.

In Camp Chatty, you meet Chatty, the mascot of Free Realms. You help the camp members feed animals and stop Bigfoot from scaring away campers. This area includes a Treasure Hunt minigame as well, along with 'Chatty Only' quests that are slightly similar to their Robgoblin counterparts.

At Camp Robbie, Robbie resides, along with a small group of local robgoblins who provide company and conversation. This area also includes a Treasure Hunt minigame, and 'Robbie Only' quests, like having to collect artifacts for Robbie, and another to help Bigfoot, a nearby gentle giant in need of aid against the opposing Camp Chatty scouts.

Gallery

Trivia
The Greenwood Forest was originally called Chugawug Bandits back in the early development of Free Realms.
In fact, most of the thugawugs are in the forest that players fight.
This area has no official name until revealed its name in 2009.

thumb|right|Archer Magical Bow Essences
thumb|right|Archer Bow Materials

thumb|right
A collection of magical bow essences. A final added touch to a bow.

Archer Magical Bow Essences is a collection for the Archer job. This collection is composed of four items: Bow Essence of Earth, Bow Essence of Fire, Bow Essence of Water, and Bow Essence of Wind. Bow Essences of Earth, Water, and Wind are acquired by clicking on Archer Materials <rare collection> in dungeons, found only while in the Archer job. Bow Essence of Fire is acquired by completion of the Archer Bow Materials collection. Completing the Archer Magical Bow Essences collection rewards players with Magical Essence Bow.

 Archer Bow Materials 

A collection of materials used in making a magical bow.

Archer Bow Materials is a collection for the Archer job. This collection is composed of eight items: Arrow Rest, Bow Comfort Grip, Bow Scope, Bow Sling, Bow Stabilizer, Lightweight Wood, Unbreakable Bow Strings, and Wood Carving Tool. All of these items except for the Lightweight Wood are acquired by clicking on Archer Materials in dungeons, found only while in the Archer job. Lightweight Wood is acquired by completion of the Archer Stories collection. Completing the Archer Bow Materials collection rewards players with 20 coins and a Bow Essence of Fire.

 Archer Stories 

A collection of stories about the sharpshooting archer.

Archer Stories is a collection for the Archer job. This collection is composed of eight items: Archer Story pg. 1, Archer Story pg. 2, Archer Story pg. 3, Archer Story pg. 4, Archer Story pg. 5, Archer Story pg. 6, Archer Story pg. 7, and Archer Story pg. 8. These items are acquired by clicking on Archer Materials in dungeons, found only while in the Arche

wiki_page.title: Cragara
wiki_page.text:
Cragara, also known as the Mysterious Merchant, is a mysterious NPC merchant that appears at locations at random offering items at random.

Generally Cragara sells items that vary from regular SC Marketplace items with large discount prices, exclusive content that isn't available through the SC Marketplace, and SC Marketplace items at store price but available in rare, exclusive colors.

Cragara is constantly relocating her shop and is not always available in Free Realms. She only offers the opportunity to purchase 4-6 different items at random and in limited quantity at each relocation.

Cragara's Shop Closed

Originally Cragara's shops were closed upon the in-game introduction of late 2012. When activated, Cragara provided dialogue explaining that she was resting after a long journey from Black Forest, an area that is located east of Stillwater Crossing.

Locations
Cragara spawns in the six following locations: Seaside, Merry Vale, Snowhill, Blackspore Swamp, Briarwood, and Sunstone Valley.

Items Cragara sells

 

 

Gallery

Trivia
Cragara is currently the only known snail in Free Realms.
However there is a snail guard in one of Free Realms roster arts we have seen, thus implying that there are more of Cragara's kind.

izandro-rageracer.title: Zandro Rageracer

wiki_page.title: Zandro Rageracer
wiki_page.text:
Zandro Rageracer is a dwarf NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Sunstone Valley questline. He is the leader of the Skullz that made his first appearance in the Skullz Base Camp when the player and the Freewheelers come to confront him. He obtained super-human features while being influenced by the mysterious magic known as the Gloam. With the Gloam abilities, he led a Skullz invasion of Sunstone Valley.

Biography
Before the events of the Freewheelers vs. Skullz, Zandro was once a normal person where he were grumpy and lonely, many the Freewheelers are enjoyed with each other and has feast in Wheelie Pete's. Zandro was the only one who started the Skullz. He challenged with Gus in a race, later Gus won in a race against Zandro. Zandro then met the stranger who is a part of the Gloam, he still don't know who she was. Zandro was influenced and obtained the Gloam abilities, then he use the power to convince the Dwarves to join the Skullz, and the gang had risen to power over Sunstone Valley.

wiki_page.title: Skullz biker gang
wiki_page.text:
The Skullz is a Dwarven Biker gang that terrorized and took over a majority of Sunstone Valley. The group is lead by Zandro Rageracer, a Gloam influenced dwarf, who constantly fought his arch-nemesis Dorn Geargrinder, who lead the main rival group of the Skullz, the Freewheelers.

History
The Skullz Biker Gang came into being thanks to the discontent that the gang's founder Zandro Rageracer had with the existing biker group, The Freewheelers. For the majority of the group's history, Zandro was one of only a few members, if not the only member, and was constantly made fun of and looked down upon as he wasn't able to match his peers in ability. This all changed when a member of the Gloam Council approached him, giving him a relic that granted the ability to beat the Freewheelers in their games. After this meetup, the Skullz gained traction and began causing havoc in Sunstone Valley, so much so that the Geargrinder brothers and other members of the Freewheelers left Sunstone Valley in search of assistance in handling them. Their arrival in Shrouded Glade came right before the invasion of the Gloam Council during the Shrouded Gloam event. 

 Gameplay 
The Skullz were formally introduced in the comic book given to players at the release of Sunstone Valley. Their part in the Sunstone Valley storyline is that of the primary antagonist, along with the other hostile races such as the Drakes, Robgoblins, and Manguanas, who have united in taking over the valley. The player's job is to take down the gang by defeating their leader, Zandro. The player progressively takes down their influence in the valley before finally squaring off with Zandro on top of their mesa located in the Southeast corner of the Valley's OWC area. His defeat rids the Gloam's influence in the area, storyline-w

wiki_page.title: Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse
wiki_page.text:
Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse, also known as Wheelie Pete's, is a local roadhouse located in Rumble Ridge, Sunstone Valley. The dwarven owner, Wheelie Pete, and his pet, Harley can be seen standing by the front entrance.

Facility
Wheelie Pete's Roadhouse is both a fueling station and a restaurant. As it is said to serve Sunstone Sasparilla and is seen to serve pizza. A fuel station and tables for eating areas are set-up in the general vicinity of Wheelie Pete's.

Turf Wars
While the Freewheelers were busy with the Gloam invasion in Shrouded Glade, the menacing group known as the Skullz took over Rumble Ridge, along with the Roadhouse. The Freewheelers later retrieved it upon completion of the Enter the Rumbledome quest.

Locals
Bronzeknuckles

During the Rumbedome battle, the Announcer states that a Rumbledome Gladiator named Bronzeknuckles came stumbling from Wheelie Pete's prior to the battle.

Ironteeth
According to Ironteeth's wanted poster, Ironteeth is wanted KO'd or alive for fighting at Wheelie Pete's.

Manguanas are a race of reptilian humanoids native to Sunstone Valley. They made their first appearance in the summer of 2012 which introduced the Sunstone Valley region. Usually found in groups, manguanas fight with claws, spears, sticky spit, and magic. They can spit a debilitating poison that damages health over time for a few seconds, and cause the player to move slower.

wiki_page.title: Rizzle
wiki_page.text:
Not to be confused with Robgoblin Junk Thief or Robgoblin Mechanic.

Rizzle is a robgoblin NPC that can be found at Whirly's Scrap Camp, located in Sunstone Valley. He is known to be very lazy compared to other robgoblins by spending all of his time sitting around and drinking Sasparilla.

Biography
Rizzle and the other robgoblins had once been proud to be lazy, until robgoblins were cut off from Glimmerdeep to creating a junk supply shortage. Currently, with junk in short supply, most robgoblins are no longer sitting around, but Rizzle still tries. He now persuades players to do his work while he spends his time drinking Sasparilla.

wiki_page.title: Holiday Gifting Tree
wiki_page.text:
thumb|300px
The Holiday Gifting Tree is a housing item that was available in the SC Marketplace during the 2011 Snow Days event for . It works in a similar fashion to the Gifting Piñata. When placed in in the player's home, it is unable to be removed for thirty days. At the end of the thirty days the tree becomes a Holiday Tree, which is able to be removed and sold.

Rewards
Every 24 hours within the thirty days, the player can click the tree for a Snow Days-themed reward. These rewards include:
Tacky Sweaters
Reindeer Outfit
Yule (Pet)
Holiday Tree Board
Toasty, Insulated, Alpine, Rugged, Thermal, or Subarctic winter wear clothing in any color.

igeoffrey.title: Geoffrey

wiki_page.title: Geoffrey
wiki_page.text:
Geoffrey is a pixie NPC featured as the main antagonist of the main questline. He is also the recurring antagonist of the Free Realms comic series. He works under Queen Valerian, through working for her, he uses his high stats for greed. Geoffrey had assassinated Queen Valerian's and Darkthorne's parents.

Geoffrey is also an NPC boss in The Queen's Last Hope. He use to fight with Gloam magic when the player fight him. After this, he fails and got defeated the player. Later the player saves the queen.

In the Free Realms comic series, however, the two main protagonists, Dane and Maya are together with Darkthorne to saves Queen Valerian from Geoffrey.

Kade, also known as  Wildclaw, is an NPC brawler. He is a member of the Realmkeepers. His deck is Chaos, and his signature weapon is Hammer of the Wolf. His ride is ironically a wolf named "Fang".

There is an outfit that can be gained by opening a TCG Heroes pack, along with the others (Crackshot, Magetech, and Ghostshadow) From the Heroes TCG questline, in which the player is tasked with defeating Baron von Darkcheat, his ride and in-game poster is available.

Biography
Very little is known about Wildclaw's backstory, he said to have became a werewolf at a young age. Madam Zelda showed him how to harness his werewolf powers to help balance his human and feral aspects.

wiki_page.text:
Jessica, also known as Crackshot, is an NPC archer. She is a member of the Realmkeepers, and a card duelist. She is the most patient and level headed of all the Realmkeepers. Her deck is Nature. Crackshot's signature weapon is the "Bow of the Sharpshooter" and her ride is a t-rex named "King".

There is an outfit that can be gained by opening a Heroes TCG pack, along with the other Realmkeepers (Ghostshadow, Wildclaw and Magetech) from the Hero's TCG questline, in which the player is tasked to defeat Baron von Darkcheat, other items such as in-game posters could be obtained.

ithe-dares.title: The Dares

wiki_page.title: The Dares
wiki_page.text:
thumb|250px
The Dares, a rock/pop band first formed by twin brothers in 2003, recorded the Free Realms officialhttp://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/the-dares-rock-free-realmstm-with-its-your-world-theme-song-61990437.html theme song, “It’s Your World” written and composed by Robbie Nevil and Matthew Gerrard exclusively for SOE.

The Dares also had the official site, seen here.

The Free Realms Theme Song
Their song, “It’s Your World”, had been written and produced for SOE as the Official Free Realms theme song, it has become iconic to Free Realms having been featured in Free Realms television spot commercialshttp://youtu.be/WSM2re7w-Z0 and featured in game performed by Bruce, a talented rockstar, in the past.

It's Your World Music Video
A music video for their song, “It’s Your World”, had been unveiled as the Official Free Realms theme song video in April 2009 in celebration of Free Realms' first birthday.http://massively.joystiq.com/2010/04/21/free-realms-unveils-its-your-world-video/

In November 2009http://www.soepress.com/content/press/press-releases/2009/11/the_dares_unveiloff.html The Dares released the official music video for “It’s Your World” which, at the time, was featured exclusivelyhttp://www.freerealms.com/article/detail.action?articleId=1269 on AOL.com.
thumb|center|335 px|It's Your World official music video

E3 2009
thumb|Promotional poster for the E3 performance
On June 2, 2009, at the world known E3 gaming exhibition, The Dares held a performance for a live concert audience at the SOE booth and simultaneously in Free Realms,http://www.soepress.com/content/press/press-releases/2009/06/rock_band_the_dares.html which earned them a plaque from the Guinness World Records for being the first time it had been done.http://massively.joystiq.com/2009/06/03/

iblackspore-swamp-house.title: Blackspore Swamp House

igd: A spooky, three-strory mansion located in the [[Blackspore Swamp]].

wiki_page.title: Blackspore Swamp House
wiki_page.text:
thumb|256px

The Blackspore Swamp House is a housing lot that is available to everyone through the SC Marketplace at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Description
thumb|Third floor. From fr.zam.com|300x300px
The house is three stories tall, the third having a balcony that you can view the front and back of the property on.

The interior floors are covered in purple tile, somewhat matching with the accents of the house. In contrast, the walls are wood-wallpaper combo of warm tones. Each floor is almost identical to each other, the only changes being the layout. 

left|thumb|320x320px|Front of lot. From fr.zam.com
The outside is dark and murky, with the thick fog making it difficult to see very far. Behind the house, there are small bodies of water, with multiple tombs farther behind it. In the front, a split path leads beyond the fog, with similar bodies of water accentuating it's sides. The path has dimly lit lampposts every few yards from each other. Along the path are trees that match the dark and mysterious feeling of the lot.

Gallery

Sources
FreeRealms Environments on Edwin Rosell

wiki_page.title: Cupcake Hat
wiki_page.text:
The Cupcake Hat is a Freestyle Jobs, head slot, clothing item that can be acquired in three different ways during the annual Birthday Bash event. The first method is via quest, the second is through the Coin Shop, and the third is from the Gifting Piñata.

Quest Version
thumb|Cupcake Hat (Quest)

The quest version of the Cupcake Hat is acquired by completion of the quest Perfecting the Batter,Freerealms: Birthday Bash: Origin Of Cakenstein on YouTube available during the Birthday Bash event. It is a blue-text item that comes in one color.

Similar to the Coin Shop version, it is a members only, nontradable clothing item.

Coin Shop Version
thumb|Cupcake Hat (Coin Shop)

The Coin Shop version of the Cupcake Hat is available during the Birthday Bash event exclusively to Members through the Coin Shop at the price of .buy it on YouTube It comes in three different color variations.

Similar to the quest version, it is a members only, nontradable clothing item.

Gifting Piñata Version
thumb|Cupcake Hat (Gifting Piñata)

The Gifting Piñata version of the Cupcake Hat is acquired from the Gifting Piñata and through trade. The Gifting Piñata was available during 2011 Birthday Bash, but can no longer be acquired.

Unlike the quest and Coin Shop versions, this version of the Cupcake Hat can be worn by non-members, traded to other players, and comes in a variety of different colors.

Sandspear is a manguana NPC boss that can be found in Sunstone Valley. wiki_page.title: Gloam Overlord
wiki_page.text:
The Gloam Overlord is an NPC featured as the antagonist of Free Realms. He has come to Sacred Grove to cause danger and harm to its people. The player must help Darkthorne defeat him and defend the Cobblestone Village from his evil forces. The Gloam Overlord and his will lieutenants try to corrupt the various regions of Free Realms, when a new evil appears, the player must defeat them.

History
Not much is known about him. But it is known that he is the leader of the Gloam and caused the battle in Shrouded Glade, and now he is causing harm to the Cobblestone Village.

Cobblestone Village
Now that the Gloam Overlord had come to the Cobblestone Village, he sent his forces to wreak havoc on its citizens. And Darkthorne has sent the player there to help and defeat the Gloam in the village. But soon enough, he will cause more harm, and its up to the player to save Sacred Grove.

itreant.title: Treant

wiki_page.title: Treant
wiki_page.text:
Treants are a plant-like sentient race. They are also one of the many different forms of life that can be found in Briarwood. Treants are large, tree-like creatures that have human characteristics, who are often guardians of nature and the forest. They are more commonly referred to as "Tree Soldiers" or "Arboreants" and often serve as monster spawners in dungeons; even though they can also serve as an uncommon enemy or a boss. Treants are almost exclusive to Briarwood, with the exception of Snowface who can be found in a dungeon in Shrouded Glade.

Sub-Races
There are currently two sub-races of treants and one undetermined treant type. All of them wield the same weapon; which is a long staff that they carry in their right hand. All of them also have the same basic body shape, and a long pointed nose.

Briarwood treants are the most common of all the treant sub-races. They have dark and dull-ish green leaves, and orange-yellowish eyes. The leaves appear to make out what is a beard, and the leaves extend all the way from it's chin to the treant's back.

Mutated treants are very different from their Briarwood brethren, in that they are covered in fungi all over their body. They still have a few dull purple leaves surrounding their head however. Unlike their Briarwood counterpart, the Mutated treants have brighly glowing yellow eyes that show no visible pupil.

There is also a currently unknown treant sub-races; Snowface appears to be what is a completely frozen over treant, but it is unknown if he is actually a completely new type of treant or a frozen Briarwood treant.

isirdo.title: Sirdo

wiki_page.title: Sirdo
wiki_page.text:
Sirdo "Squirrel Chaser" is a human NPC that can be found south-east of the Blackspore warpstone. He hosts a series of quests. The quests involve building a reputation for Sirdo and having revenge on Donovan.

Biography
In the past, Sirdo has been known to be one of the best thieves aroundhttps://freerealms.fandom.com/wiki/Quest:Bad_Reputation up until he messed up on a critical mission involving the task of spying on the newly exiled Princess Lavender. Sirdo had followed her into Briarwood, and as he turned a corner, he had lost Lavender's location, all he saw were squirrels.https://freerealms.fandom.com/wiki/Quest:The_Last_Laugh

In result of this mishap, his employer, Donovan Shadeweaver, had fired him, and the others gathered squirrels to follow Sirdo in shame. His nickname had then been established as Sirdo "Squirrel Chaser".

Later Sirdo attempted to redeem his reputation. He began hiring the player to steal supplies from nearby camps in Blackspore Swamp, he then had them deliver a group of squirrels on Donovan's property. Sirdo then changed his nickname to Sirdo "King of Squirrels".

Quests
Quest:Bad Reputation
Quest:The Last Laugh
Quest:What's In a Name?

wiki_page.title: Gus Geargrinder
wiki_page.text:
Gus Geargrinder was a dwarf NPC. He was the leader of the famous Dwarven Biker gang from Sunstone Valley known as the Freewheelers that made his debut in the Shrouded Glade invasion where the Druids and Dwarves were trapped in Shrouded Glade that was under invasion.

Gus had sacrificed himself in order to defeat the Gloam that terrorized Shrouded Glade during the Gloam Invasion. His brother, Dorn, became his successor and took leadership of the Freewheelers.

A statue was built in honor of Gus Geargrinder's bravery on the Druid Academy's campus located in Shrouded Glade.

itraining-saddle-of-gliding.title: Training Saddle of Gliding

wiki_page.title: Training Saddle of Gliding
wiki_page.text:
thumb
The Training Saddle of Gliding is an item that can be permanently equipped to any glide-trainable rides such as untrained Bats, Dragons, Feathered Drakes, Pegasus, or Phoenix rides. 

The saddle is acquired through completing all 5 steps of Troy Ridewrangler's Glide Training. After glide training is complete, the player is rewarded with a Glide Training Certification, which enables the player to purchase additional Training Saddle of Glidings from the Station Cash Marketplace at the price of  and to Members at the %10 discount price of .
How to use
To train a glide-trainable ride using a Training Saddle of Gliding, players are required to equip a saddle onto their Item Belt, in the user interface, and activate it. A menu then appears prompting the player to choose an eligible ride of the rides they own. 

A Training Saddle of Gliding is consumed after training one ride. 
Sources
All About Gliding on Free Realms Support

wiki_page.title: Pony Vale
wiki_page.text:
Pony Vale is a region of land in the mountains located west of Sunstone Valley connected by the Mystical Barrier.

Questline

 Questline Overview: 
The questline for ponyvale is a short storyline that introduces you to the area and its residents and sees you assisting the ponies in tackling a new threat.

Peppermint:
Quest: Warm Welcome

Honeydew:
Quest: Helping Honeydew
Quest: Meeting the Princess
Quest: Distracting Druids

Quest: Allergy Season Already?

Quest: Unicorn's Plight
Quest: Nature's Cure
Quest: Stopping the Spread

Princess Dreamdust:
Quest: Investigating the Cause
Quest: Gathering Evidence

Yarith Yewroot:
Quest: Sweets for Sniffles

Gallery

Trivia
At SOE Live 2012, it was said that Pony Vale had been planned to be part of the next big update.https://www.engadget.com/2012-10-26-soe-live-2012-an-exclusive-look-at-the-future-of-free-realms.html
Later on SOE Live 2013, it was said Pony Vale and another zone had not met current expectations in the terms of size and will not be focused on for the time being.
Pony Vale became publicly accessible through the Mystical Barrier on January 28th, 2014.
Pony Vale's questline and mobs were partially introduced in-game on February 4th, 2014.
Pony Vale was the last region added before Free Realms closed on March 31st, 2014.
Pony Vale is the only known location in Sunstone Valley that is not a desert area.

Loot Card

Ironteeth Wanted Poster is a Virtual Reward Series 5 loot card acquired from placing 4th-8th place on select Trading Card Game Tournaments. Once redeemed, one Wanted Poster: Ironteeth Housing item was received through the redeeming player's communicator. The card's ID is 5P8.

wiki_page.text:
Jason Maskface is a human NPC that occasionally comes out on Friday the 13ths. When spawned, he roams the Greenwood Forest around the camps looking to recruit players to scare other players. wiki_page.title: Changelings
wiki_page.text:
Changelings are a mutated race of pixies that were stuck above ground during the Unbinding. The large waves of magic from the Unbinding mutated their bodies and minds, along with limbs transformed into elements of land such as sticks, branches, and stones. Most changelings are known to be sad, bitter creatures because of what happened to them and how people treat them now.Free Realms: The Official Handbook and Strategy Guide, Tracy West, page 83

Changelings appear in many dungeons and in Sacred Grove. During the Festival of Hearts, a group of changelings known as the Heart Breakers attempt to ruin the event and steal all of the love.

Notable Changelings

Behavior
Many of the changelings appear to be very unapproachable and hostile in nature. Their mutations have caused them to be mangled and considered ugly by some, so they often feel like an outcast race in Sacred Grove. Many changelings can be found isolated or alone in the corners of cities, towns, and even within their own small sanctuaries out in the Wilds.

Despite their sour behavior, some of the changelings still have good hearts, and will often help the player or give them quests to do to help.

iraven.title: Raven

wiki_page.title: Raven
wiki_page.text:
Raven is a harpy NPC boss featured as the primary antagonist in the Hero Rises questline. Disguised as the Bixie Queen, she attempted to take over Wugachug using gloamwater sarsaparilla. When inside the party tent, at the end of the Chug-a-Mug Challenge battle, she will appear outside the tent to tells the contestants to stop fighting. After the player come to fight Raven in Highroad Junction, she fails and got defeated by the player.

Battle
In the old tutorial area, in Highroad Junction as a world boss. When Raven is there, massive logs will appear and she will fly between them. To get up, you must find some green tornadoes and jump where they are. This will rocket you up and you can land on them. The teleport is quite frequent so be fast. Once defeated, Raven drops Raven's Treasure Chest, bixies will appear and the logs will not be there.

Gallery

Trivia
Raven was introduced in the update of August 13th, 2013.
Raven is currently the only known harpy in Sacred Grove, although Chugzy mentions that harpies are from Lavender Coast, thus implying that there are more of her kind.
Two world bosses, Raven and Nekark were supposed to have Level 20 Awakened fights similar to Necronomicus, but they were never completed before the game shut down.

Chugzy was introduced in the update of August 13, 2013.
Chugzy is currently the only known elf in Sacred Grove, although he wasn't the first introduced in-game because we seen a female elf in the Memorial Caverns Murals and a male elf named Elvis in the Free Realms Issue 3 which aren't introduced in-game until the only one elf was introduced.
However there are two elves; a female elf in the Memorial Caverns Murals and Elvis in the Free Realms Issue 3 we have seen, thus implying that there are more of Chugzy's kind.
Also a female elf from the Memorial Caverns Murals and Elvis from the Free Realms Issue 3 seem to has peach skin color, thus implying that there are different skin colors of the elf race.

wiki_page.text:
General Wugashima is a chugawug enemy NPC that appears on a mountaintop located south of Wugachug during the quests Countering the Calvary and Elf Ex Machina. He is the general of the Flying Pig Dogo Ninjawugs, and one of Raven's minions while influenced by the Gloam throughout the Bugawug Queen quest series.

Ninjawug Outpost
Ninjawug Outpost is a difficulty 2 battle available during the quest Ex Elf Machina.

thumb|Gloam obilisk
During the quest named Elf Ex Machina, the player is sent to stop General Wugashima who is preparing a ninjawug attack on Wugachug by the order of Bixie Queen, Raven. During the first confrontation with General Wugashima, he claims the player's arrival was expected and begins attacking. Once defeated, he summons Ninjawugs of the Flying Pig Dojo to attack, and continues to respawn the Ninjawugs after defeat until a Gloam obilisk is destroyed by Chugzy.

Once the Gloam obilisk is destroyed, General Wugashima is no longer under the influence of Queen Raven and becomes an ally.

wiki_page.title: Baron von Darkcheat (character)
wiki_page.text:
Were you looking for the Booster Pack or the costume?

Baron von Darkcheat is an NPC card duelist featuring as the primary antagonist of the TCG Heroes/Baron von Darkcheat questline. He is primarily at odds with the Realmkeepers (Crackshot, Magetech, Ghostshadow, and Wildclaw), Madam Zelda, and the player. The player must choose a “Realmkeeper” Cardie deck in the game to combat him, as he is threatening all of Sacred Grove with his own evil Mystery Chest Cardie deck. He is also said to have created the Gloamstone, a presumably ancient weapon that would further aid in his evil plans.

With their decks, players must win enough games against Baron and his three henchmen to ensure that Baron’s deck loses its power and fades from existence, foiling Baron’s plans to become King of Free Realms and plunge Sacred Grove into darkness.

Similar to the Realmkeepers, there is also an outfit that can be gained by opening a Heroes TCG pack. From the packs, in-game décor such as trophies in the likeness of the Baron could also be obtained. On top of this, the Gloamstone becomes an obtainable hoverboard for players who complete the questline.

wiki_page.text:
Tiger the Party Animal is a human NPC that spawns during Themed Community Event Parties. Currently there are only three types of Themed Parties: Luaus, Pet Parties, and Winter Holiday Parties.

Luau
Referees host a Luau themed party during the summer season in a variety of locations. During these parties, Tiger will offer the A Luau quest to players.

Pet Party
Referees host Pet Parties several times a month in a variety of locations, during these parties, Tiger will offer the Party for Pets quest to players.

wiki_page.title: Free Realms: The Official Handbook and Strategy Guide
wiki_page.text:
Free Realms: The Official Handbook and Strategy Guide is a book written by Tracey West, and published by Scholastic on November 1st, 2010.
The book covers much of the basic information of Free Realms prior to 2011. Although since Free Realms has changed largely since 2010, the book is currently out of date. Currently this, along with the Free Realms: How to Draw Heroes and Villains, are the only Official Free Realms published books.
Publisher's summary
Back cover
Welcome to the exciting and magical world of Free Realms - the online adventure game that is a global sensation!

When you enter Free Realms, you become part of a fantastic world, one where fairies and other mystical creatures mix with humans. You can go on unforgettable quests and unlock secrets and surprises, all while making friends from around the world. Plus you can master several careers to give you an edge.

This handbook and strategy guide outlines everything you'll need to know about the game. From learning basic skills to completing quests, to getting to know Free Realms' characters and creatures, with the help of this guide you'll be a Free Realms expert in no time!
Includes
thumb|Included posterAs advertised on the cover, the book includes a Poster and a promotional code. The code included is ICECREAMSURPRISE, which grants a consumable named Ice Cream Surprise that contains a Snowflake Effect for 30 minutes. The poster included depicts a labeled map of the Sacred Grove atlas.

Behind the scenes
The cover states that the book is written by Aaron Rosenberg, where as most big-name websites found online say that it is in fact written by Tracey West.

wiki_page.text:
Free Realms: How to Draw Heroes and Villains is a book written by Ron Zalme, and published by Scholastic on November 1st, 2010.
The book is a step-by-step guide to drawing iconic characters from Free Realms. Currently this, along with the Free Realms: The Official Handbook and Strategy Guide, are the only Official Free Realms published books.

Publisher's summary
Back cover
There are many exciting characters and creatures in Free Realms. Now you can learn to draw them all! Inside this book are step-by-step instructions on sketching all of the heroes and villains of the Free Realms world - including Queen Valerian, Darkthorne, Chatty, Bob the Robgoblin, and Chugawugs and Thugawugs!

What are you waiting for? Grab a pencil - it's Free Realms time!

ilavender-coast.title: Lavender Coast

wiki_page.title: Lavender Coast
wiki_page.text:
Lavender Coast was an unreleased location that was never opened to denizens of Sacred Grove. It would've been located to the far south of Lavender Coast Pass, with the warpstone nearby which its entrance is blocked by barriers. Few official details were known about Lavender Coast.

The elf known as Chugzy also mentioned that harpies like Raven are native to Lavender Coast during the Heroes Journal quest titled, Raven, Lunatic.

Like other unreleased locations, Lavender Coast was never added to Free Realms before it was closed on March 31, 2014.

Gallery
Concept Arts

Designs

Trivia
Lavender Coast would have contained a lake of molten lava, as seen through the concept art by Edwin Rosell, and referenced through the in-game description of the purple dragon Pet Pal, Embers.
It is unknown why Lavender Coast got its name when it is all lava lakes and volcanoes. It is possible that the ocean would've be viewable in the location, just like Seaside, but it is separate between water and lava.

Sources
The Free Realms Filter on SlideShare
FreeRealms Environments on Edwin Rosell
FreeRealms Eye Candy on The Dog'n Pony Show!

itoeny.title: Toeny

wiki_page.title: Toeny
wiki_page.text:
Toeny is a large "toe" pet pal that was distributed throughout the month of October 2013 as apart of October's Monthly Membership Pack Items.

Gallery

Trivia
Toeny was initially revealed publicly on September 9th, 2013 through a tweet on Twitter by Free Realms producer Steve "Shock" George. The tweet featured an early version image of Toeny as a whiteboard sketch.
On September 19th, 2013 Toeny was featured in a tweet by Free Realms producer Steve "Shock" George that included a completed image of Toeny.
During the Free Realms downtime on October 1st, 2013 a tweet by Free Realms producer Steve "Shock" George featured a teaser image of Toeny.
Toeny was introduced in game on the update of October 1st, 2013.
The name "Toeny" is a portmanteau of the words "Toe" and "Tony".

iabacus-coinmiser.title: Abacus Coinmiser

wiki_page.title: Abacus Coinmiser
wiki_page.text:
Abacus Coinmiser was an elderly human NPC that was no longer in-game. Originally, he could be found near Coin Farmer Dang Dang in Sanctuary from October 8, 2013 through December 18, 2013.

Abacus's dialogue mentioned of a coin crash approaching due to inflation based on the bank minting too many coins, warning players to spend all of their coins before they are worthless.

Dialogues

Gallery

Trivia
On October 7, 2013, Free Realms Producer Steve "Shock" George tweeted a pre-release teaser image featuring Abacus.
The meaning of "Abacus Coinmiser" is to count, but avoid spending, earned coins.
The name "Abacus" refers to an ancient calculating tool, of the same name, that is widely used by merchants in eastern continents.
The name "Coinmiser" is a compound of the words: "coin", as in money; and "Miser", reluctance of spending.

Sources

wiki_page.title: S.M.A.C.M.
wiki_page.text:
The Super Maximum Assembled Cyber Mech, more commonly abbreviated as the S.M.A.C.M., also known as the Combined Ride, is a mechanical ride that is acquired through completing the "United We Stand" achievement: purchase all 5 Combiner Rides.

Gallery

Trivia
On October 28, 2013, Free Realms Producer Steve "Shock" George tweeted an advertisement image that featured the S.M.A.C.M. ride.#FreeRealms R.U.RED.E for S.M.A.C.M. ? on Twitter The following day the S.M.A.C.M. ride was introduced in-game, on October 29, 2013.
On October 4th, 2013, Free Realms lead designer Justin "Mourde" Dazet publicly revealed the ride's official name, "S.M.A.C.M.", through Twitter.Anyone want to see S.M.A.C.M.? on Twitter
Through the Official Free Realms Forums, Producer Steve "Shock" George has posted threads featuring the S.M.A.C.M. in forms such as: concept art on March 22, 2013; on a "Work-In-Progress" photograph on August 13, 2013; and a further developed model screenshot on September 6, 2013.
The S.M.A.C.M. was featured through a live webcast on Twitch, held by Free Realms producer Steve "Shock" George on October 11, 2013Free Realms Live Twitch-Cast on Twitch with Free Realms lead designer Justin "Mourde" Dazet, and on October 15, 2013Free Realms with Beau and Producer Steve George! on Twitch with Massively representative Beau Hindman.

wiki_page.title: Free Realms Issue 1
wiki_page.text:
The correct title of this article is Free Realms #1. The substitution or omission of the # is because of technical restrictions.

Free Realms #1 was the first issue in the Free Realms series of comics based on the game of the same name. It was published on July 29, 2009 by Wildstorm.

Publisher's summary
SONY teams with WildStorm and best-selling fantasy author J.S. Lewis (the Grey Griffins series) for an exciting adaptation of Free Realms, their new MMORPG! This 12-issue series mirrors the nonstop action of the game, offering exciting adventures, battles with vicious monsters and, of course, the allure of gorgeous fairies! The story begins when a young girl is abducted and dragged into a darkened forest teeming with twisted monsters. It's up to a relic hunter and a pixie to save her, but their mission is cut short when a horde of troll-like creatures captures them!

ithe-scrutinizer.title: The Scrutinizer

wiki_page.title: The Scrutinizer
wiki_page.text:
The Scrutinizer is an NPC that can be found in the downtown located in Sanctuary during the HeroRealms Month.

Gallery

Trivia
The Scrutinizer was first revealed publicly over Twitter by Free Realms Lead Designer Justin "Mourde" Dazet on December 18, 2013,Who is THE SCRUTINIZER? And what does he want with the Realms..? on Twitter and was featured through a teaser image on December 19, 2013.What IS he doing..? on Twitter
On January 13, 2014, Free Realms Producer Steve "Shock" George posted an advertisement image featuring the Scrutinizer.HeroRealms starts tomorrow! BAM! POW! CRACK! on Twitter
The Scrutinizer was introduced in-game on January 14, 2014.
The character "The Scrutinizer" appears to be inspired by the Watchers from the Fantastic Four series. To scrutinize means to examine or inspect, a variation of to watch.

params.text: A collection of creepy sites and places where ghouls roam in Blackspore.

wiki_page.title: Exploration (Collections)
wiki_page.text:
Blackspore

 Splortata's Camp: Northwestern corner of the region in a large, hollow tree. Look for the light of the campfire.
 Mucklewhump's Ferry: Northeast of the main area of the city here. Look for a hut and a little pier. The collection spot is on the pier.
 Relic Excavation Site: Southern area of the region, northwest of the Quagmire Quarry.
 Blackspore Pet Adoption: Southeastern section of the main area of the city, near the lake.
 Quagmire Quarry: Southwestern area of the region.
 Sinking Cemetery: Southern half of the region, within the big graveyard in the east.
 Oberyn's Retreat: Just south of the main area of the city, in a little tree hollow camp.

Blackspore Rare Exploration

 Mortal Resting Place
 Sinking Hopes
 Ghastly Mining
 Beyond Watchful Eyes
 Gravestone Peek-a-boo

Briarwood - Briarheart

NB! Briarheart was only able to be accessed by successfully finishing the Tanglewood Fort dungeon, until recent updates made all Warpstones available.
 Briarheart Caverns: The tunnel leading to Briarheart.
 Briarheart Castle: Northern area, next to the warpstone.

wiki_page.title: Green Watch
wiki_page.text:
The Green Watch is a druid camp located in west of the Skysong Ledge in Pony Vale. It serves as a druid research base dedicated to studying Pony Vale. Known druids involved with the Green Watch are Lorel Leafsense, Xeydia, and Yarith Yewroot.

Questline
The Pony Vale questline involves a suspicious horse, Sadie, watching Green Watch. Sadie requests players to distract the druids while she searches through Green Watch supplies for evidences confirming that the druids are up to no good.

While distracting the druids, the player will meet Yarith Yewroot, one of the druid researchers at the Green Watch. Yarith explains his observations of odd allergy-related behavior in the Unicorn Forest, and assists the player in finding a cure.

Gallery

Trivia
The Green Watch was officially introduced as part of the Pony Vale questline and mobs were introduced in-game on February 4, 2014.
